title: Dynamic Validator Quickstart: interactive art & stepper
creator: Ava Chen
description: Create a set of onboarding and quickstart visuals that demonstrate the Dynamic JSON Validator experience in the Structured Output docs. Focus is on interactive stepper art, real-time validation micro-interactions, and a compact hero image for the docs landing page. Deliverables will include annotated screenshots, export-ready SVG/PNG assets, a short animated GIF showing inline validation, and copy for microcopy/tooltips.
acceptance_criteria: Hero illustration for docs landing (1200x600) that visually conveys schema-first authoring
Three stepper mockups (onboarding steps: Define schema -> Try examples -> Validate in console) with desktop and mobile variants
Animated GIF (max 5s, 800x450) showing realtime validation highlights and error-to-fix flow
Annotated screenshot pack (dark/light) for docs and PR with layer notes and asset filenames
Microcopy file with tooltip strings and accessibility notes delivered as a single doc link
decisions: Use progressive disclosure: hide advanced schema knobs behind an 'Advanced' expander in the stepper to reduce cognitive load for first-time users
Prefer a compact hero illustration that integrates a console screenshot crop rather than a full UI render to keep asset maintenance low
Include both dark and light mode screenshots for parity with Console theming
Animated GIF will focus on a single error fix cycle (invalid type -> inline suggestion -> auto-fix suggestion accepted) to keep file size small
review_feedback: PM: prefer clearer call-to-action copy in step 3 — replace 'Validate' with 'Run validation'
Eng: ensure GIF sequence uses mocked but realistic console state; coordinate with ENG-4221 for fixture data
Accessibility reviewer: increase contrast on success badges; provide text alternatives for GIFs in docs
Design lead: tone should be friendly and developer-focused, not tutorial-heavy — trim copy by ~30%

2025-02-14: Wireframes complete for all three steps; picked color system from Console tokens (dark/light).
2025-02-15: First-pass hero illustration sketched; sharing with PM for wording check.
2025-02-17: Animated GIF storyboard approved by Eng; requested final PNG exports for documentation.
2025-02-18: Preparing annotated screenshots; awaiting ENG-4390 integration test data for final GIF render.
next_steps: Finalize microcopy and hand off to localization team for initial strings (link in design_links)
Export PNG/SVG assets and upload to Drive folder; add file names to assets_needed when exported
Record short demo video (10-15s) for internal release notes; coordinate with comms
Open GH PR linking these assets into docs site (refer to ENG-4221 for docs integration)
Schedule design review for 2025-02-20 to sign off on final screenshots
mockup_tasks: Create desktop stepper mockups in Figma with callouts for each micro-interaction
Design the inline validation chips (error, suggestion, accepted) as a tokenized component
Produce mobile-optimized stepper variants and export @2x PNGs
Generate annotated PDFs showing layer names and export settings for engineering handoff
Produce final GIF using recorded Console capture and trimmed storyboard frames
notes: Keep file sizes optimized for the docs CDN (limit hero to <300KB when possible). Coordinate closely with ENG-4221 and ENG-4390 for ground-truth schema fixtures used in GIFs. If engineering cannot provide stable fixtures before 2025-02-24, create GIF with annotated mock data and mark as 'example-only' in the alt text.
